title: String methods and formatting

spans.text: WHY USE THIS?
String methods trim whitespace, normalize search input, and split delimited fields.
CORE EXPLANATION

strip()

spans.title: Watch out
spans.text: A regex does not make input safe for SQL, HTML, or a URL; use context-appropriate escaping or parameters.
COMMON MISTAKES
String methods return transformed text rather than changing the original; a regex checks only the pattern you specify.
